resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two lookouts are catalogued under Cass Lake: a 1911 state steel tower of about 70 feet northwest of town, and the 1936 redwood tower behind the Supervisor's Office. Readable sources do not tie the record's coordinates to either one; the story covers the 1936 tower.

notes_for_editor: Star Tribune article 'Where towers once stood' returned HTTP 429 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, so it was not read. A search snippet from it says the redwood tower was dismantled in the late 1940s; that is unverified and not used. Staffing, notable fires and access are not in any readable source, so they are omitted. Check the record coordinates (47.37916, -94.6146) against the 1936 site before publishing.
